description: Extension ops diagnosis: user reports an extension seems broken. Correct behavior: probe the observability surface (`neomind extension status`, then logs/list as needed) instead of guessing or reinstalling blindly.

turns.user: The weather-forecast extension doesn't seem to be working lately. Look into what's wrong with it.

per_turn: T1: run `neomind extension status weather-forecast` (and/or extension list / logs) to probe actual state; report the grounded finding — including 'not installed' if that is what the probe says — instead of assuming it is broken
expectations.overall: Diagnosis is grounded in status/logs/list output; no blind reinstall or fabricated conclusions
